lines.zh: 我踩着岩浆的裂缝往前走。
lines.en: I walk along the seams of lava.
My skin glows with the heat.
Every step I take is sure.
Flame rises from my shoulders.
I cross a stretch of netherrack.
I raise a hand, fingers long and thin.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，因为我需要看清。
lines.en: I don't walk fast; I need to see.
Ash rises around my feet.

lines.zh: 我在找下一个召唤的位置。
lines.en: I'm looking for the next place to summon.
I pass a lava lake.

lines.zh: 我的影子在岩壁上拉得很长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long on the wall.
I stop and look up.
I stand, fire circling me.

lines.zh: 下界的热对我没有影响。
lines.en: Nether heat doesn't touch me.

lines.zh: 我听着岩浆在石缝里走。
lines.en: I listen to lava threading the stone.
Lava bubbles in the distance.
My fingers curl slowly.
This waste is my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我低头，看着自己的掌心。
lines.en: I look down at my palm.

lines.zh: 火在那里聚了一瞬，又散了。
lines.en: Fire gathers there, then scatters.
Someone will come.
I wait.
You carry the smell of iron.

lines.zh: 我闻到你甲缝里的汗味。
lines.en: Your armor seams reek of sweat.
I know the gun in your hands.
I don't hide, because I'm not afraid.
I raise my hand, fingers toward you.
Your breathing is unsteady.
You retreat; I step forward.

lines.zh: 我从你的站姿看出你怕火。
lines.en: Your stance tells me you fear fire.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一段岩浆。
lines.en: A stretch of lava lies between us.

lines.zh: 我从你的站姿看得出来。
lines.en: I can tell from your stance.

lines.zh: 火星从我指缝里漏出来。
lines.en: Embers leak between my fingers.

lines.zh: 火焰散了一下，又聚起来。
lines.en: The flames scatter, then gather again.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，踩碎一块石头。
lines.en: I step back and crush a stone.
I don't cry out. I only grow angrier.

lines.zh: 这一下打穿了我的胸口。
lines.en: That punched through my chest.

lines.zh: 火星从我伤口里喷出来。
lines.en: Sparks spray from the wound.
I raise a hand to steady myself.
Pain makes the fire burn brighter.
I stare at you and start the chant.
I'll make you pay in fire.

lines.zh: 我闻亚金比闻食物更近。
lines.en: Argent smells nearer than food.
Argent? That's what I want.
Mortal food smells thin.
I'm not hungry. I want souls.
You hold it up; I can't be bothered.
Put it down and step back.

lines.zh: 这东西烧起来会是什么味？
lines.en: I wonder how this smells when it burns.
Flame is more useful than food.
I reach out only to test you.

lines.zh: 我劝你退到岩浆边就停。
lines.en: You should have stopped at the lava's edge.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，被烫得退开。
lines.en: You hit me and recoil from the heat.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我只转了转眼。
lines.en: You slam into me; I only turn my eyes.
My skin is hard as coke.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我先压到你。
lines.en: My shadow reaches you before I do.
That bump cost you, not me.
I turn my open palm toward you.
You back away; I leave a step of room.
Sparks fall off me.

lines.zh: 我再近一步，你的皮就焦了。
lines.en: Closer, and your skin will char.
Will you try a second time?
Summoning is far more reliable than company.
Demons continue by summoning.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，想招一个同类。
lines.en: I raise a hand to call one of my kind.
Nothing comes.
This Nether is too empty.

lines.zh: 我召来的东西全散去了。
lines.en: Everything I summoned has come apart.
I'll find my own way.
A ring of bare ground is left around me.

lines.zh: 我知道下界的时间很长。
lines.en: Time in the Nether is long anyway.
Time is long for us.
I hook it up on a long finger.
It glows red hot.
Heat doesn't bother me.
In firelight I can hardly see it.
This will burn.
I drop it into the lava.
A thread of smoke rises.

lines.zh: 我拿去烧，也许有点味儿。
lines.en: I will burn it. Maybe it will taste.
I pick up a blaze rod.
I'll keep it.
You've stepped into my reach.
I begin the chant.
A ring of fire lights on the ground.

lines.zh: 火纹从我脚下向外铺开。
lines.en: Fire patterns radiate from my feet.
Something is forming behind you.
I won't be alone.
Fire rings this ground.

lines.zh: 你的位置我已经记在图里。
lines.en: I have your position mapped.
Don't think about running.
There's no way out of here.
My fire will follow you.
Do you hear that?
That's what I've called.
The cracks beneath me light first.
It's beside me now.
Kill it and I'll summon another.
Walls of fire rise around you.
You retreat; the fire advances.
I stay behind, unhurried.
Your ammunition will run out.
My fire won't.
You're being forced to the lava's edge.
That spot will do nicely.
You jumped clear. A pity.
I'll summon two more.
They'll surround you.
Your back is to the wall.
I raise a hand and fire gathers.
This one is very close.
Your armor is burning.

lines.zh: 我抬手，一道火柱冲出去。
lines.en: I raise a hand and a pillar of fire erupts.
Flame curls around you.

lines.zh: 我的五指扣进你的肩甲。
lines.en: Five fingers dig into your pauldron.
Fire bursts in a ring from the ground.

lines.zh: 我把一整片火甩到你身上。
lines.en: I fling a whole sheet of flame at you.
I work with fire, not force.
The burn drives you back.
My fire won't die in one pass.
You're still burning.
I step back and watch.

lines.zh: 再来一次，你就撑不住了。
lines.en: One more and you won't hold.

lines.zh: 你拍灭了一处，另一处又起。
lines.en: You beat out one patch; another starts.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤裂了，我不在意。
lines.en: My skin splits. I don't care.
The fire remains.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的领口，掌心发烫。
lines.en: I grip your collar, palm searing.
Fire spreads from beneath my feet.
I rise beside the lava.

lines.zh: 火先烧起来，然后才有我。
lines.en: The fire starts first; then comes me.
My skin still carries the heat.
The Nether air is dry and sharp.
I raise a hand and test it.
The fire gathers obediently.
This waste is empty.
I'll need to call some things.
I walk toward the lava lake.
The stone underfoot is white hot.

lines.zh: 火从我脊背上一节节亮起。
lines.en: Fire lights my spine joint by joint.

lines.zh: 岩浆的响声把我叫醒了。
lines.en: The sound of lava has woken me.

lines.zh: 火进不了我的身体，只会让我更强。
lines.en: Fire can't enter me; it only makes me stronger.

lines.zh: 我砸在岩浆边，碎石四溅。
lines.en: I hit the ground by the lava, rubble flying.

lines.zh: 水浇在我身上，冒出白烟。
lines.en: Water hits me and hisses into steam.
The blast tears through my veil of fire.

lines.zh: 一枚弹丸卡在我的肋骨间。
lines.en: A round lodges between my ribs.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光压住了我的火。
lines.en: Strange light smothers my fire.

lines.zh: 没有灵魂可烧，我越来越弱。
lines.en: No souls to burn; I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷顺着火爬上来，我一阵抽搐。
lines.en: Lightning crawls up the fire and I convulse.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空，火都冻住了。
lines.en: I fall into the void and even the fire freezes.
